columns.name: TOOL_ID
columns.description: The Unique Identifier of the Gen AI Tool in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: TOOL_CODE
columns.description: Code of the Gen AI Tool in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Type of the Gen AI Tool in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: SUB_TYPE
columns.description: Sub Type of the Gen AI Tool in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: FAMILY
columns.description: Product family of the Gen AI Agent in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: PRODUCT
columns.description: Product area of the Gen AI Agent in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: TOOL_CREATED_DATE
columns.description: Created Date of the Gen AI Tool in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: OWNER_ID
columns.description: ID of the owner who created the Gen AI Tool in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: OWNER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the owner who created the Gen AI Tool

columns.name: NAMESPACE
columns.description: Namespace of the Gen AI Tool in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the Gen AI Tool in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: VERSION
columns.description: Version of the Gen AI Tool in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: HIDDEN_FLAG
columns.description: Hidden flag of the Gen AI Tool in the Agentic Workflow. Y or N

columns.name: USER_INPUT_REQUIRED
columns.description: This column determines whether user input is reauired to use this Tool.

columns.name: SPECIFICATION
columns.description: Specification that can provide additional information for the use of the Tool.

columns.name: INTERNAL_NAME
columns.description: This column represents the system name of the Tool.

columns.name: INTERNAL_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: This column represents the system description of the Tool.

columns.name: SEEDED_FLAG
columns.description: Seeded flag of the Gen AI Tool in the Agentic Workflow. Y or N

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
